title: smtp credential_file failure silently became fatal (undocumented behavior change)
description: Before secretx work: crates/smtp/src/server.rs had warn!(failed to load credential_file) and continued running. After the secretx change, the non-secretx else branch now calls eprintln! + process::exit(1). This affects operators who configured a credential_file path and were relying on the daemon starting anyway (using only inline auth.users). On upgrade they will now get a silent startup failure. The behavior change is not documented in the commit message, RUNBOOK, or changelog.
